name: docent
description: Explain software with a short narrated video: change walkthroughs with before and after, tours of web apps and command-line tools, and deep dives into backends and data pipelines with diagrams and highlighted source. Local voice narration, captions and chapters.

interface.shortDescription: Explain software with a narrated video
interface.longDescription: Turn a change, an app or a codebase into a short narrated video. Change mode explains a branch, pull request or release, with before and after. Tour mode introduces a whole web app or command-line tool. Deep-dive mode explains how a backend or data pipeline works with animated diagrams and highlighted source. Docent runs the real software locally, records with a visible pointer, narrates with a local voice, and assembles a captioned 1080p MP4 with chapters.
defaultPrompt: Make a walkthrough of this branch.
Give me a narrated tour of this app.
Make a deep-dive video on how this pipeline works.
